 else

 end if;
 --

 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 --if :ctrl_block.start_date < trunc(sysdate) then

 show_error('11101');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 trunc(:ctrl_block.start_date) > trunc(:ctrl_block.end_date) then
 show_error('11065');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM

declare
 x_count number;
BEGIN
nullchk;
check_package_failure;
IF :resexp_block.drive_date 
 not between :ctrl_block.start_date and :ctrl_block.end_date 
THEN
 show_error('14005');
 check_package_failure;
ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT count(*) 
 INTO x_count
 FROM resource_exceptions
 WHERE trunc(drive_date) = :resexp_block.drive_date
 and resource_code = :ctrl_block.resource_code
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 
 IF x_count > 0 THEN
 show_error('0069');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 :resexp_block.day := to_char(:resexp_block.drive_date,'DY');
 END IF;
 END ;
ENd IF;

BEGIN
 SELECT max_available
 INTO :resexp_block.max_avail
 FROM resource_avail_rules
 WHERE week_day = to_char(:resexp_block.drive_date, 'DY')
 and resource_code = :ctrl_block.resource_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 and chapter_id =:global.chapter_id;
EXCEPTION when no_data_found then
 :resexp_block.max_avail := 0;
END ;
END ;

ProgramUnit.Name: INITIALISE_WINDOWS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--Modified for Y2K.....MG.....6/99
PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
 h_rtn_status VARCHAR2(1) := '';
BEGIN
 --:global.program_version := '1.01.08';
 --:global.program_version := '2.03.01';
 --:global.program_version := '3.01.00';
 --:global.program_version := '02' ;
 --:global.program_version := '03'; -- IM# 4681
 --:global.program_version := '04'; -- IM# 4780
 --:global.program_version := '05'; -- IM 4780 added chapter specific condition
 --:global.program_version := '06'; -- IM 4780 drive date to chapter condition.
 --:global.program_version := '07'; -- IM# 5320
 --:global.program_version := '08'; -- IM 8497
 --:global.program_version := '09'; -- Duplicate objects removal from GRP_LAF_STND
 
 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 :global.program_version := '01';
 
 execute_trigger('util_banner');
 :system.message_level := '10';
 set_toolbar;

 /*
 ** load global variable far_out_days from "valid_parameters" table.
 */
 begin
 select to_number(parameter_value)
 into :global.far_out_days
 from valid_parameters
 where parameter_type = 'ALL' -- this parameter affects all
 and parameter_code = 'REXDY' -- parameter code name (very important)
 and (term_date >= sysdate OR term_date is null);

 exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Cannot load global parameter.', acknowledge);
 exit_form(no_validate);
 
 end;

 /*
 ** set toolbar for control block
 */
 modify_toolbar_buttons('ctrl_block');
 RESEXP_BLOCK_enable_disable('D');
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: MODIFY_TOOLBAR_BUTTONS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE modify_toolbar_buttons (status varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 /*
 ** set button status according to passed parameter.
 */
 if status = 'ctrl_block' then
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_record', enabled, property_true);

 set_item_property('toolbar.enter_query', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.cancel_query', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.execute_query', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.next_block', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.insert', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.delete_record', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.previous_block', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_block', enabled, property_false);


 elsif status = 'resexp_block' then
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_record', enabled, property_TRUE);
 set_item_property('toolbar.insert', enabled, property_FALSE);
 set_item_property('toolbar.delete_record', enabled, property_FALSE);
 set_item_property('toolbar.previous_block', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.enter_query', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.cancel_query', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.execute_query', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.next_block', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_block', enabled, property_false);
 end if;
END;

/*
** following buttons can be enabled / disabled
*/

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE QUERY_DATA IS
D_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) 
 INTO D_COUNT
 FROM RESOURCE_EXCEPTIONS
 WHERE drive_date between :ctrl_block.start_date 
 and :ctrl_block.end_date
 and resource_code = :ctrl_block.resource_code;
 IF D_COUNT = 0 THEN
--message('St'||:ctrl_block.start_date||'--end'||:ctrl_block.end_date);pause;
--message('res--'||:ctrl_block.resource_code);pause;
 SHOW_ERROR('11091');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RETRIEVE_DATA IS
query_string varchar2(200);
BEGIN

if :ctrl_block.start_date is null then
 show_error('11064');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
elsif :ctrl_block.end_date is null then
 show_error('11067');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
elsif :ctrl_block.resource_code is null then
 show_error('11001');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
Check_Resource_Avail;
check_package_failure;
GO_BLOCK('RESOURCE_AVAIL_RULES');
CLEAR_BLOCK(no_validate);
EXECUTE_QUERY;

RESEXP_BLOCK_enable_disable('E');
query_string := 'trunc(drive_date) between :ctrl_block.start_date and :ctrl_block.end_date and resource_code = :ctrl_block.resource_code and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id';
GO_BLOCK('RESEXP_BLOCK');
SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('RESEXP_BLOCK',default_where,query_string);
CLEAR_BLOCK(no_validate);
EXECUTE_QUERY;
IF :RESEXP_BLOCK.drive_date is null then
 go_item('resexp_block.drive_date');
ELSE
 go_item('resexp_block.available_number');
END IF;
modify_toolbar_buttons('resexp_block');
ctrl_blk_enable_disable('D');

END;

PROCEDURE check_resource_avail IS
v_count number;
BEGIN

 SELECT count(*) 
 INTO v_count
 FROM resource_avail_rules
 WHERE resource_code = :ctrl_block.resource_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate);
 --and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;

 IF v_count = 0 THEN
 show_error('11007');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 End If;
 
END;

declare
 msg number;
begin
 select count(msg_id)
 into msg
 from alert_log
 where user_id = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid
 and read_date is null;
 
 if msg > 0 then
 set_item_property('toolbar.pb_alerts',label,'Msg: '||to_char(msg));
 end if;
exception
 when program_error then
 null; 
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRFRM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin

 ctrl_blk_enable_disable('E');
 End If;
 clear_form(no_validate);
 initialise_windows;
end;
